title: migration-risk-analysis-skill Output
description: Output summary for migration risk classification and execution plan

overall_risk_level.description: Highest risk level among all individual migration steps. A migration is DESTRUCTIVE if any step is DESTRUCTIVE.

description.description: What this step does (e.g., 'Add nullable column bio to users table').

rollback_plan.description: Exact SQL or Prisma command to revert this step. For REVERSIBLE changes, a single DROP statement. For DESTRUCTIVE, reference to phased plan.

data_loss_on_rollback.description: Whether rolling back this step causes data loss.

requires_maintenance_window.description: Whether this step requires a maintenance window.

zero_downtime_eligible.description: True if the entire migration can run during a rolling deployment without maintenance window.

phased_plan_required.description: True if any DESTRUCTIVE step is present. Phased plan must be included in Deployment_Strategy.md.

phased_plan.description: Three-phase plan for DESTRUCTIVE migrations. Required when phased_plan_required is true.

phase_1.description: Application change to soft-delete or shadow the data.

phase_2.description: Deploy and monitor phase. Duration recommendation.

phase_3.description: Destructive migration step with backup confirmation requirement.

migration_command_valid.description: True if the migration will use prisma migrate deploy for staging/prod. False if prisma db push is detected.

risk_register_entries.description: RISK-NNN entries to append to Risk_Register.md.

deployment_strategy_section.description: Markdown section to append to Deployment_Strategy.md. Includes risk summary table and execution plan.
